consequence.statement: Kafka node certificates are now stored in separate Secrets, one Secret per pod; environments that consume these certificate Secrets should verify they still reference the right Secret after the upgrade.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 stores Kafka node certificates in separate Kubernetes Secrets, one Secret per pod, changing how the operator manages node certificate storage.
